Melany Solange Krywoj (born 27 February 1998) is an Argentine tennis player.
She has a career-high doubles ranking of No. 166 by the WTA , achieved on 11 November 2024, and a best singles ranking of world No. 526 reached on 15 January 2024. [ 1 ] She has won 12 doubles titles on the ITF Circuit. She won her first $75k title at the Palmetto Pro Open in the doubles draw, partnering Alicia Herrero Liñana . [ 2 ] She played collegiate tennis for the Baylor Bears in Texas.
